description: Registry of installable Agentic Beaver community skills. An agent reads this file, picks a skill by id, and copies skills/<path>/ into its own skills directory, then follows that skill's SKILL.md.

install.how: For a chosen skill, copy the entire folder at skills/<path>/ into your agent's skills directory (e.g. .../skills/<id>/), then read its SKILL.md. Each skill is self-contained: SKILL.md + optional docs/, references/, scripts/.

skills.name: Cold Email — Full Outbound Pipeline
skills.description: End-to-end cold outbound sales pipeline: SCRAPE → ENRICH → CRM → RESEARCH → WRITE → SEND, plus reply and objection handling.
